verdict.rationale: Every Greptile review comment has a "Fix with your Agent" button. It sends the issue, with file paths, line numbers and suggested code, to Claude Code, Codex, Conductor, Cursor or Devin, and a "Fix All" button in the review summary sends every issue at once, so an agent-generated follow-up can be launched directly from the PR. MCP auto-fix and "Greplooping" add iterative fixing until the review has zero unresolved comments. missing for 10: no evidence of a direct one-click committed patch or suggestion-commit on the PR, no documentation that agent fixes land back on the PR without switching to the agent's environment, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the fix flow.
